name: Courage Quest
street_address: University of Rhode Island, Chafee Hall, Suite 100
description_short: A small therapeutic day camp at URI in Kingston for children with mild to moderate anxiety. Campers play games, take on themed challenges and practice coping skills such as breathing, self talk and facing fears step by step, led by a licensed psychologist.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund minus a $50 fee for cancellations at least 30 days before camp starts; no refunds after that except for documented medical emergencies.
special_needs_notes: Built for children with mild to moderate anxiety, including those already diagnosed. About 3 campers per staff member. No nurse on site; staff trained in first aid and CPR. Nut free.
